facts.text: Aurora Anguilla spans Rendezvous Bay and Merrywing Bay, with accommodations on both shores.
facts.excerpt: Aurora Anguilla spans 300 acres across Rendezvous Bay and Merrywing Bay, with accommodations on both shores.

facts.text: The resort's grounds cover over 380 acres.
facts.excerpt: you’ll find it amongst our over 380 acres of alluring paradise

facts.text: Merrywing Bay is a stretch of beach directly in front of the resort, known for calm waters, golden sand and sunsets.
facts.excerpt: A tranquil stretch of beach located directly in front of Aurora Anguilla. Known for its calm waters, golden sand, and stunning sunsets

facts.text: Rendezvous Bay looks across the channel to St. Martin.
facts.excerpt: Famous for its turquoise waters and breathtaking views of St. Martin across the channel

facts.text: Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport (AXA) is located minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Anguilla’s main airport, located just minutes from Aurora Anguilla.

facts.text: The resort has a waterpark with slides and a lazy river.
facts.excerpt: waterpark with slides and a lazy river

facts.text: The resort describes its pickleball complex as the Caribbean's largest.
facts.excerpt: the Caribbean’s largest pickleball complex

facts.text: The resort's golf club has a Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and a 9-hole short course, Avalon Links.
facts.excerpt: Aurora International Golf Club’s stunning Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and 9-hole short course, Avalon Links

facts.text: The resort's golf course is the only golf course on Anguilla.
facts.excerpt: As the one and only golf course on the island

facts.text: The International Course is par 72 and 7,165 yards.
facts.excerpt: PAR 72 \| 7,165 YARDS

facts.text: The International Course's 18th hole begins with a tee shot over a salt pond and climbs forty feet to a green guarded by three bunkers.
facts.excerpt: It begins with a demanding tee shot over the salt pond, followed by an ascent of forty feet to reach a narrow green meticulously guarded by three imposing bunkers.

facts.text: The golf academy has two instructional bays with Trackman simulators.
facts.excerpt: With two instructional bays equipped with Trackman simulators

facts.text: Menus draw on the resort's 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens, which supply produce, herbs and fruit every day.
facts.excerpt: our 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens. These gardens provide fresh produce, herbs, and fruits every day.

facts.text: The resort has six diverse dining options ranging from casual to upscale.
facts.excerpt: six diverse dining opportunities, each offering a different experience from casual to upscale

facts.text: Chef's Table serves family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven.
facts.excerpt: Fresh-baked pastries and family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven

facts.text: D Richard's is a steakhouse located at the Aurora International Golf Club.
facts.excerpt: Located at the Aurora International Golf Club, D Richards is the best (and only) steakhouse in Anguilla.

facts.text: Tokyo Bay is Executive Chef Joe Richardson's modern take on classic Japanese cuisine, with sushi and sashimi.
facts.excerpt: Executive Chef Joe Richardson whose deep respect and study of Japanese culture inspired this authentic, modern take on classic Japanese cuisine. Explore a robust menu of fresh sushi and sashimi

facts.text: Sole di Mare serves Mediterranean dishes including handmade pastas and pizzas, with views of the sea and Saint Martin.
facts.excerpt: From handmade pastas and pizzas to vibrant dishes inspired by the South of France, Greece, Spain, and Morocco

facts.text: A new beach club is due to debut in November 2026.
facts.excerpt: A New Beachfront Icon Debuts November 2026

facts.text: Sorana Spa has twelve treatment rooms, including two couples suites, with views of Rendezvous Beach.
facts.excerpt: Our twelve treatment rooms include two couples suites and a custom-designed with a sand quartz table made for specific treatments. With luxurious facilities and views of Rendezvous Beach

facts.text: Sorana Spa offers steam, sauna and hydrotherapy experiences.
facts.excerpt: spa amenities include a co-ed relaxation, steam, sauna, and hydrotherapy experiences

facts.text: Sorana Spa closes seasonally from August 17 through October 15 as part of the seasonal closure of the Rendezvous section of the resort, reopening October 16.
facts.excerpt: Sorana Spa will be temporarily closed from **August 17 through October 15** as part of the seasonal closure of the Rendezvous, Aurora Anguilla Resort & Golf Club.

facts.text: All non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach.
facts.excerpt: all non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach

facts.text: The Aurora Explorers Club offers supervised activities for young guests, including arts and crafts, games and storytelling.
facts.excerpt: the Aurora Explorers Club invites young guests to discover, create, and connect through a thoughtfully curated program of supervised activities

facts.text: The pool complex has a splash pad, zero-entry pool, lazy river, slide tower and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: The stunning family-friendly pool complex features a splash pad, zero entry pool, lazy river, slide tower, and private and family cabanas.

facts.text: The Aurora Entertainment Park includes a tennis center, pickleball courts, a climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts and a 9-hole mini golf course.
facts.excerpt: The new Aurora Entertainment Park features a world-class tennis center, pickleball courts, climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts, and a 9-hole mini golf course.

facts.text: The Aurora Amphitheatre hosts events from live music to movies under the stars, with the Caribbean Sea and St. Martin as a backdrop.
facts.excerpt: Set against the backdrop of the Caribbean Sea and St. Martin on the horizon, Aurora’s state-of-the-art amphitheatre offers an incredible selection of events from live music performances to movies under the stars.

facts.text: Guided cave tours are run in partnership with the Anguilla National Trust and Katouche Tours.
facts.excerpt: guided cave tour, presented in partnership with the Anguillan National Trust and Katouche Tours

facts.text: Accommodations include luxury rooms, suites, villas and estate homes.
facts.excerpt: Take your pick from Luxury Rooms, Suites, Villas, and Estate Homes.

facts.text: Estate guests have private swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: Estate guests can lounge by their private swimming pools

facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide gave the resort a 4 Star designation in 2025.
facts.excerpt: 4 Star Designation 2025- Aurora Anguilla Resort & Golf Club

facts.text: The Caribbean Travel Awards named the resort Caribbean Golf Resort of the Year in 2025.
facts.excerpt: The Caribbean Travel Awards - “Caribbean Golf Resort of the Year”

facts.text: Anguilla has daily direct commercial flights from Miami with American Airlines.
facts.excerpt: Direct commercial flights are available daily through Miami (MIA) to Anguilla (AXA) with American Airlines.

facts.text: The resort offers water transfer options to and from St. Maarten.
facts.excerpt: WATER TRANSFER OPTIONS TO AND FROM ST. MAARTEN

contradictions.note: p1 says 300 acres, p11 says over 380 acres
